032        protected Set<String> tags = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
033        @Override
034        public void init(CargoStackAPI stack) {
035                super.init(stack);
036                
037                String param = spec.getParams();
038                if (!param.isEmpty()) {
039                        for (String tag : param.split(",")) {
040                                tag = tag.trim();
041                                if (tag.isEmpty()) continue;
042                                tags.add(tag);
043                        }
044                }
045        }

075        @Override
076        public void render(float x, float y, float w, float h, float alphaMult,
077                                           float glowMult, SpecialItemRendererAPI renderer) {
078                
079                SpriteAPI sprite = Global.getSettings().getSprite("blueprint_packages", getId(), true);
080                if (sprite.getTextureId() == 0) return; // no texture for a "holo", so no custom rendering
081                
082                
083                float cx = x + w/2f;
084                float cy = y + h/2f;
085                
086                w = 40;
087                h = 40;
088                
089                float p = 1;
090                float blX = cx - 12f - p;
091                float blY = cy - 22f - p;
092                float tlX = cx - 26f - p;
093                float tlY = cy + 19f + p;
094                float trX = cx + 20f + p;
095                float trY = cy + 24f + p;
096                float brX = cx + 34f + p;
097                float brY = cy - 9f - p;
098                
099                List<String> ships = getProvidedShips();
100                List<String> weapons = getProvidedWeapons();
101                List<String> fighters = getProvidedFighters();
102                boolean known = areAllKnown(ships, weapons, fighters);
103                
104                float mult = 1f;
105                
106                sprite.setAlphaMult(alphaMult * mult);
107                sprite.setNormalBlend();
108                sprite.renderWithCorners(blX, blY, tlX, tlY, trX, trY, brX, brY);
109                
110                if (glowMult > 0) {
111                        sprite.setAlphaMult(alphaMult * glowMult * 0.5f * mult);
112                        sprite.setAdditiveBlend();
113                        sprite.renderWithCorners(blX, blY, tlX, tlY, trX, trY, brX, brY);
114                }
115                
116                if (known) {
117                        renderer.renderBGWithCorners(Color.black, blX, blY, tlX, tlY, trX, trY, brX, brY, 
118                                         alphaMult * 0.5f, 0f, false);
119                }
120                
121                renderer.renderScanlinesWithCorners(blX, blY, tlX, tlY, trX, trY, brX, brY, alphaMult, false);
122        }

139        @Override
140        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, CargoTransferHandlerAPI transferHandler, Object stackSource) {
141                super.createTooltip(tooltip, expanded, transferHandler, stackSource);
142                
143                float pad = 3f;
144                float opad = 10f;
145                float small = 5f;
146                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
147                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
148                Color b = Misc.getButtonTextColor();
149                b = Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor();
150                
151                List<String> ships = getProvidedShips();
152                List<String> weapons = getProvidedWeapons();
153                List<String> fighters = getProvidedFighters();
154                
155                float maxTotal = 21;
156                int minPer = 3;
157                
158                float shipWeight = 0f;
159                float weaponWeight = 0f;
160                float fighterWeight = 0f;
161                
162                FactionAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
163                
164                float knownWeight = 0.25f;
165                for (String id : ships) {
166                        if (pf.knowsShip(id)) {
167                                shipWeight += knownWeight;
168                        } else {
169                                shipWeight += 1f;
170                        }
171                }
172                for (String id : weapons) {
173                        if (pf.knowsWeapon(id)) {
174                                weaponWeight += knownWeight;
175                        } else {
176                                weaponWeight += 1f;
177                        }
178                }
179                for (String id : fighters) {
180                        if (pf.knowsFighter(id)) {
181                                fighterWeight += knownWeight;
182                        } else {
183                                fighterWeight += 1f;
184                        }
185                }
186                
187                float totalWeight = shipWeight + weaponWeight + fighterWeight;
188                if (totalWeight < knownWeight) totalWeight = knownWeight;
189                
190                int maxShips = (int) Math.max(minPer, (shipWeight / totalWeight) * maxTotal);
191                int maxWeapons = (int) Math.max(minPer, (weaponWeight / totalWeight) * maxTotal);
192                int maxFighters = (int) Math.max(minPer, (fighterWeight / totalWeight) * maxTotal);
193                
194                
195                if (!ships.isEmpty()) {
196                        addShipList(tooltip, "Ship hulls:", ships, maxShips, opad);
197                }
198                if (!weapons.isEmpty()) {
199                        addWeaponList(tooltip, "Weapons:", weapons, maxWeapons, opad);
200                }
201                if (!fighters.isEmpty()) {
202                        addFighterList(tooltip, "Fighters:", fighters, maxFighters, opad);
203                }
204                
205                
206
207                addCostLabel(tooltip, opad, transferHandler, stackSource);
208                
209                if (!Global.CODEX_TOOLTIP_MODE) {
210                        boolean known = areAllKnown(ships, weapons, fighters);
211                        if (known) {
212                                tooltip.addPara("All blueprints in package already known", g, opad);
213                        } else {
214                                tooltip.addPara("Right-click to learn", b, opad);
215                        }
216                }
217        }
218        
219        protected boolean areAllKnown(List<String> ships, List<String> weapons, List<String> fighters) {
220                
221                for (String hullId : ships) {
222                        if (!Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().knowsShip(hullId)) {
223                                return false;
224                        }
225                }
226                for (String weaponId : weapons) {
227                        if (!Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().knowsWeapon(weaponId)) {
228                                return false;
229                        }
230                }
231                for (String wingId : fighters) {
232                        if (!Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().knowsFighter(wingId)) {
233                                return false;
234                        }
235                }
236                return true;
237        }

262        @Override
263        public void performRightClickAction() {
264                List<String> ships = getProvidedShips();
265                List<String> weapons = getProvidedWeapons();
266                List<String> fighters = getProvidedFighters();
267                
268                if (areAllKnown(ships, weapons, fighters)) {
269                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().getMessageDisplay().addMessage(
270                                        "All blueprints in package already known");//,
271                } else {
272                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playUISound("ui_acquired_blueprint", 1, 1);
273                        FactionAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
274                        int sCount = 0;
275                        int wCount = 0;
276                        int fCount = 0;
277                        for (String id : ships) {
278                                if (!pf.knowsShip(id)) sCount++;
279                                pf.addKnownShip(id, true);
280                        }
281                        for (String id : weapons) {
282                                if (!pf.knowsWeapon(id)) wCount++;
283                                pf.addKnownWeapon(id, true);
284                        }
285                        for (String id : fighters) {
286                                if (!pf.knowsFighter(id)) fCount++;
287                                pf.addKnownFighter(id, true);
288                        }
289                        
290                        if (sCount > 0) {
291                                Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().getMessageDisplay().addMessage(
292                                                "Acquired " + sCount + " ship blueprints", Misc.getTooltipTitleAndLightHighlightColor(),
293                                                "" + sCount, Misc.getHighlightColor());
294                        }
295                        if (wCount > 0) {
296                                Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().getMessageDisplay().addMessage(
297                                                "Acquired " + wCount + " weapon blueprints", Misc.getTooltipTitleAndLightHighlightColor(),
298                                                "" + wCount, Misc.getHighlightColor());
299                        }
300                        if (fCount > 0) {
301                                Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().getMessageDisplay().addMessage(
302                                                "Acquired " + fCount + " fighter blueprints", Misc.getTooltipTitleAndLightHighlightColor(),
303                                                "" + fCount, Misc.getHighlightColor());
304                        }
305
306                }
307                
308                if (stack != null) {
309                        SpecialItemSpecAPI spec = stack.getSpecialItemSpecIfSpecial();
310                        if (spec != null && spec.hasTag(Tags.CODEX_UNLOCKABLE)) {
311                                SharedUnlockData.get().reportPlayerAwareOfSpecialItem(spec.getId(), true);
312                        }
313                }
314        }

316        public static List<String> getWeaponIds(Set<String> tags) {
317                List<WeaponSpecAPI> specs = Global.getSettings().getAllWeaponSpecs();
318                
319                Iterator<WeaponSpecAPI> iter = specs.iterator();
320//              while (iter.hasNext()) {
321//                      WeaponSpecAPI curr = iter.next();
322//                      if (curr.getAIHints().contains(AIHints.SYSTEM)) {
323//                              iter.remove();
324//                      }
325//              }
326                
327                if (!tags.isEmpty()) {
328                        iter = specs.iterator();
329                        while (iter.hasNext()) {
330                                WeaponSpecAPI curr = iter.next();
331                                for (String tag : tags) {
332                                        boolean not = tag.startsWith("!");
333                                        tag = not ? tag.substring(1) : tag;
334                                        boolean has = curr.hasTag(tag);
335                                        if (not == has) {
336                                                iter.remove();
337                                                break;
338                                        }
339                                }
340                        }
341                }
342                
343                Collections.sort(specs, new Comparator<WeaponSpecAPI>() {
344                        public int compare(WeaponSpecAPI o1, WeaponSpecAPI o2) {
345                                return o2.getSize().ordinal() - o1.getSize().ordinal();
346                        }
347                });
348                
349                List<String> result = new ArrayList<String>();
350                for (WeaponSpecAPI spec : specs) {
351                        result.add(spec.getWeaponId());
352                }
353                return result;
354        }

377                                
378                                for (String tag : tags) {
379                                        boolean not = tag.startsWith("!");

399                for (ShipHullSpecAPI spec : specs) {
